scope: 22 synthetic original FireAt radial-launch and BulletFire controls: retail segments10/ROT20/speed255, complete ten-index fan, body-facing and signed counter edges, zero/negative segment and vertical controls, and a post-fan arc failure.
assumptions: Each case starts a fresh emulator with the pinned retail executable. Synthetic source, target, type, weapon, Bullet, Rules, virtual table and stack state supply the FireAt tail at 0x006FE8EE; constructors, full FireAt admission, aim selection and retail INI loading are not executed.

Source X/Y are 1280/1280; Rules gravity is 6. The producer supplies delta, speed and selected type flags. Unwritten mapped fixture memory and native BSS remain zero; this is not a Windows process initialization claim.

Ambient x87 control word is 0x0E7F: 53-bit precision, truncation, masked exceptions. Native velocity bytes are observed as binary64 including signed zero; this corpus does not establish physical x87 hardware equivalence.

Execution must reach 0x006FF01A or the failed-launch boundary 0x006FF93C within 200000 instructions and the checked runner's time limit. Both FireAt stack and persistent Bullet velocity are retained because positive ROT renormalizes the copied vector. Failed-launch vector/pitch bytes are observations, not valid launched velocities.
RadialFireSegments and old per-source counter are supplied. The ten-index rows cover the stock Aegis fan; no Python arithmetic determines the observed heading or next counter.

Body and turret Facing objects have supplied destination words and zero turn rates; original Facing::Current4C93D0 returns the body word. Distinct turret words verify that the fan ignores turret facing.
Both native RNG streams start from original constructor seed31; their complete 0x3F4-byte states are hashed before and after. Entering Random65C780 or RandomRanged65C7E0 is an error.
bits is the FireAt pre-Fire stack velocity; fired_bits is the persisted Bullet velocity after ROT normalization. launch_scalar and radial_next are observed original fields.
substitutions: Virtual GetType/GetWeapon and the selected class gate return supplied type/weapon references and a fixture class value. Native source location getter 0x005F65A0 remains executable.

World SetLocation 0x005F4EC0 copies the requested coordinates to Bullet+0x9C, sets Bullet+0x90 to 1 and returns success. Display Remove 0x004A9770 and Submit 0x004A9720 return success. World admission, registration, map state and those leaf bodies are excluded.
